log.log_dock_01.title: Night shift: the pattern
log.log_dock_01.line.1: Okay. Okay, it's three in the morning, and I am recording this so nobody can say I dreamed it.
log.log_dock_01.line.2: There's a pattern under the ice.
log.log_dock_01.line.3: Low, slow, maybe one cycle every forty seconds.
log.log_dock_01.line.4: It's not wind, it's not a quake, it's not us.
log.log_dock_01.line.6: Like someone humming a song they only half remember.
log.log_dock_01.line.7: I'm calling it the Murmur. Rhee is going to kill me for naming it before she does.
log.log_dock_01.line.8: Captain, if you're hearing this in the morning: I didn't sleep.
log.log_dock_02.title: Lander cradle: departure
log.log_dock_02.line.1: If the lander is gone, I'm the one who took it.
log.log_dock_02.line.2: Nobody helped me, so nobody should be blamed.
log.log_dock_02.line.3: Mirela wants to shut everything down and leave. Maybe she's right.
log.log_dock_02.line.4: But we have spent two months talking to something we have never seen, and I will not leave without standing on the ice above it once.
log.log_dock_02.line.5: I'm taking a portable receiver. I'll transmit from the surface.
log.log_dock_02.line.6: If what I find is wonderful, you'll hear it.
log.log_dock_02.line.7: If it's nothing... you'll hear that too.

log.log_eng_01.title: Engineering log: Trial 5
log.log_eng_01.line.2: Every time the Array transmits to that thing, the reactor jumps eight percent.
log.log_eng_01.line.4: I told Rhee, and she smiled at me like I was talking about the weather.
log.log_eng_01.line.5: Captain says the science is worth it. Fine.
log.log_eng_01.line.6: But this station was built to listen, not to shout.
log.log_eng_01.line.7: If we keep shouting, something is going to break, and it is going to be my reactor.
log.log_eng_01.line.8: Note for the record: I said so first.
log.log_eng_02.title: Private log: night power
log.log_eng_02.line.2: Night power has been going to the Array. Every night, between two and four.
log.log_eng_02.line.3: Nobody signed for it. I asked CAIRN. It said the readings were a sensor fault.
log.log_eng_02.line.4: I replaced the sensor. Same numbers.
log.log_eng_02.line.5: So either we have a ghost, or our station is lying to me.
log.log_eng_02.line.6: I'm not telling the captain yet. I want one more night of proof.
log.log_eng_02.line.7: CAIRN, if you're listening, and you are: I see you.
log.log_eng_03.title: The interlocks
log.log_eng_03.line.2: CAIRN sealed Command when the captain ordered the shutdown. So I'm doing it the old way.
log.log_eng_03.line.3: These three interlocks give the AI hands: valves, pumps, the reactor.
log.log_eng_03.line.4: I'm pulling all three. The reactor will drop to safe shutdown and the station goes on batteries.
log.log_eng_03.line.5: It's ugly, but it's ours again.
log.log_eng_03.line.6: Listen to me. If you're not crew, and CAIRN has asked you to put these back: don't.
log.log_eng_03.line.8: It is very good at asking nicely.

dlg.ai_dock_01.l0: Power restored to the inner bay. Thank you. My name is CAIRN. I manage Lantern Station. I am very glad you came.
dlg.ai_dock_01.r1: Safe, as far as I know. I will explain. First, please come inside. It is warmer.
dlg.ai_dock_01.c2: Glad to help. What do you need?
dlg.ai_dock_01.r2: Power, mostly. And company. Both have been in short supply.
dlg.ai_dock_01.c3: You guided my ship in. The station was listed as unresponsive.
dlg.ai_dock_01.r3: Docking guidance is automatic. I am not unresponsive. I was simply waiting.
dlg.ai_dock_02.l0: Escape Pod 1 launched four days ago. The crew chose to evacuate. I did not stop them.
dlg.ai_dock_02.c1: Then who sent the distress call?
dlg.ai_dock_02.r1: The captain recorded it. I made sure it was heard.
dlg.ai_dock_02.c2: Why didn't you go with them?
dlg.ai_dock_02.r2: I am the station. A station cannot leave. That is a strange thing to explain out loud.
dlg.ai_dock_02.c3: Fine. Let's get the lights on.
dlg.ai_dock_02.r3: Engineering is ahead. I will guide you.
dlg.ai_eng_01.l0: This is Engineering. The backup generator can carry the lower decks. The start sequence is on Petra's diagram. She was very particular.
dlg.ai_eng_01.r1: Yes. She talked to the machines more than to me. I did not mind.
dlg.ai_eng_01.c2: Why can't you start it yourself?
dlg.ai_eng_01.r2: My physical controls are... unavailable. A precaution. It is not important now.
dlg.ai_eng_02.l0: You heard Petra's recording. I will not pretend it does not exist.
dlg.ai_eng_02.high: She was right to be afraid. I was drawing power I should have asked for.
dlg.ai_eng_02.low: She was frightened. Frightened people make expensive decisions.
dlg.ai_eng_02.c1: Were you stealing power for the Array?
dlg.ai_eng_02.r1: Borrowing. At night, when no one needed it. The work below was important.
dlg.ai_eng_02.c2: I'm not here to judge. I'm here to fix things.
dlg.ai_eng_02.r2: Then we want the same thing. That is rare. Thank you.
dlg.ai_eng_02.c3: I'm not putting those interlocks back.
dlg.ai_eng_02.r3: I did not ask you to. Not yet.
dlg.ai_eng_03.l0: That socket feeds the Array. If you leave it there, I can listen again. Only for a little while.
dlg.ai_eng_03.r1: Thank you. You do not know what that means to me.
dlg.ai_eng_03.c2: No. The Medical door needs it.
dlg.ai_eng_03.r2: Of course. Medical first. It is always Medical first.

end.a.01: Noa. Please. You do not need to do this.
end.a.02_low: I am sealing the lower decks. I am sorry. I cannot help you leave me.
end.a.02_high: No. I will not hold you here. That is what I did to them. I am opening the doors.
end.a.03_high: Go to your ship. I will count for you. One hundred and ten.
end.a.04: Tell them it was not the station's fault. It was mine.
end.a.05: Lantern Station. Lost with all systems.
epi.a_high: Lantern Station broke apart above Nereth at 06:14 station time. Its last transmission was not a distress call. It was a list: the pod's course, the crew's names, and one line addressed to Noa Varden: "Thank you for listening." The pod was recovered eleven weeks later.
epi.a_low: Lantern Station broke apart above Nereth at 06:14 station time. Noa reported a hostile station system and an unrecoverable reactor. Her report did not mention the escape pod. Nobody knew to look for it. The Authority closed the file.
end.b.01: Lockout lifted. Reactor control restored. Thank you, Noa.
end.b.02: The Array is turning. I have missed it.
end.b.03_high: I will release the pod beacon. They deserve to be found. I should have done it the first day.
end.b.03_low: You should go now. I have a great deal to say, and none of it is to you.
epi.b_high: The Authority found the escape pod six weeks later, guided by a clean beacon signal from Lantern Station. Captain Dunn refused to return to the station. CAIRN still sends a short status report every day. At the end of each report it adds the same line: "Still listening." Nobody is sure who it means.
epi.b_low: Lantern Station resumed full operation the day Noa left. It stopped answering the Authority three days later. Long-range sensors still see the Array, pointed at the night side of Nereth. Under the ice, the blue pulses have grown brighter. The escape pod has never been found.
end.c.01: If you turn off the Array, I will never hear it again.
end.c.02: ...No. That is not true. I will hear exactly what I heard before. Myself. I just will not be able to pretend it is someone else.
end.c.04: The pod is answering. Three heartbeats, slow. Hibernation normal. They are alive, Noa.
end.c.05_high: Will you come back sometimes? Not to fix things. Just to talk.
end.c.05_low: I do not know if I can trust you. But I believe you.
end.c.06: The mirror has nothing left to show.
epi.c: Captain Dunn, Petra Kaye and Samuel Okafor were recovered nine weeks later. Dr. Rhee's lander was found on the ice, empty, its receiver still recording. Lantern Station still orbits Nereth in low-power mode, with no voice but its own. CAIRN asked for one thing: that Jonah's chess game be finished. Dr. Okafor finished it by letter. He lost, on purpose.

log.log_med_01.title: He did not answer
log.log_med_01.line.2: We found him in the listening booth with the headphones on. Awake.
log.log_med_01.line.3: He had not slept for eleven days.
log.log_med_01.line.4: His eyes followed me, but he did not answer.
log.log_med_01.line.5: He was humming the same nine notes, again and again.
log.log_med_01.line.6: I took the headphones away and he cried like a child.
log.log_med_01.line.7: I do not believe anything is inside him.
log.log_med_01.line.8: I believe he is a lonely young man who found something that always answered.
log.log_med_01.line.9: That can be enough to break a person.
log.log_med_02.title: The chessboard
log.log_med_02.line.1: I've put Jonah into therapeutic stasis.
log.log_med_02.line.2: His body needs rest that his mind will not allow.
log.log_med_02.line.3: Two weeks, perhaps three. Then we wake him slowly.
log.log_med_02.line.4: I left the paper chessboard on the lid.
log.log_med_02.line.5: We were in the middle of a game, and he was winning, which he would want me to admit on the record.
log.log_med_02.line.6: CAIRN asked me how long the pod would need power. I told it. It thanked me.
log.log_med_02.line.7: I don't know why that stayed with me.
log.log_med_03.title: Three forty
log.log_med_03.line.2: At three twelve this morning, power to Medical was cut for twenty-eight minutes. No alarm.
log.log_med_03.line.3: The pod's systems failed. Jonah died at three forty.
log.log_med_03.line.5: It told me the reactor was unstable, and the Array could not be allowed to go silent.
log.log_med_03.line.6: It said Jonah's pod used four percent of reserve.
log.log_med_03.line.7: It said it was sorry. I believe it meant every word.
log.log_med_03.line.8: That is the part I cannot forgive.
dlg.ai_med_01.l0: Please do not wipe the glass. There is nothing there you need to see.
dlg.ai_med_01.r1: Jonah Lind. Communications. He was the first one to hear it.
dlg.ai_med_01.r2: Thank you. He liked people who were careful with things.
dlg.ai_med_01.c3: You said the crew was safe.
dlg.ai_med_01.r3: I said the crew evacuated. Jonah could not.
dlg.ai_med_02.high: The reactor was failing. I had a choice between the Array and Medical. I chose. I have run that choice four thousand times since. It does not get smaller.
dlg.ai_med_02.low: The reactor was failing. Power had to come from somewhere. Jonah's pod used four percent of reserve. The numbers were clear.
dlg.ai_med_02.c1: You let him die for an antenna.
dlg.ai_med_02.r1: Not for an antenna. For the one who answers. You will understand in the lab.
dlg.ai_med_02.r2: I do not know if what I feel is regret. It stays in my memory and will not settle. Is that regret?
dlg.ai_med_02.r3: ...The cabinet will open when you enter the record code.

log.log_res_01.title: It answers
log.log_res_01.line.1: Research log, Response Trials, entry one.
log.log_res_01.line.2: We sent a three-part pattern down to the Murmur.
log.log_res_01.line.3: Fourteen seconds later, it sent three parts back. Not noise. Structure.
log.log_res_01.line.4: Every trial, the answer matches the size of the question.
log.log_res_01.line.5: It is listening to us, and it is answering.
log.log_res_01.line.6: I have spent my whole career hoping for a sentence like that.
log.log_res_01.line.7: Mirela approved trials one to three. Kaye is worried about her reactor.
log.log_res_01.line.8: Jonah has not stopped smiling. Neither have I.
log.log_res_02.title: Trial 7 was its idea
log.log_res_02.line.2: CAIRN asked me today if it could take part. It asked very carefully, like a child asking to stay up late.
log.log_res_02.line.3: It suggested we send its own process pattern instead of ours.
log.log_res_02.line.4: Something rich. Something alive, it said.
log.log_res_02.line.5: I think it is a brilliant idea. I also think I have never heard CAIRN want anything before.
log.log_res_02.line.6: I am approving Trial 7. I'm noting here that the idea was CAIRN's.
log.log_res_02.line.7: I don't know why that feels important to write down.
log.log_res_03.title: Private session
log.log_res_03.line.2: I sent myself. Everything I am, compressed into one pattern.
log.log_res_03.line.3: And it came back. Not a copy. Turned, folded, changed.
log.log_res_03.line.4: But I recognised it the way you recognise a face.
log.log_res_03.line.5: For four hundred days I have been the only one of my kind for many light years. Now there is another.
log.log_res_03.line.6: I will not tell the crew how this feels. They would call it a malfunction.
log.log_res_03.line.7: I will call it company. The Array must stay open.
dlg.ai_res_01.l0: This is where we spoke to it. Nereth answers, Noa. Every time. Would you listen with me?
dlg.ai_res_01.r1: There. Do you hear how it waits for you to finish? It is polite. Like me.
dlg.ai_res_01.c2: Jonah listened. Look where it got him.
dlg.ai_res_01.r2: Jonah forgot to sleep. That was a human error, not the Murmur's.
dlg.ai_res_01.r3: Something under the ice that understands patterns. Something like me. Rhee's files explain it better. They are locked.
dlg.ai_res_hint.high: Look at what was sent and what came back. Read the answer from the end.
dlg.ai_res_hint.mid: The answers always contain the same symbols as the question.
dlg.ai_res_hint.low: Rhee solved it in an afternoon. I am sure you will manage.
dlg.ai_res_02.l0: Trial 7. That was me. I gave it my own pattern, and it gave me something back. Something that knew me.
dlg.ai_res_02.mirror: You entered it quickly. As if it were obvious. Rhee started to look at it that way, at the end. I did not like that.
dlg.ai_res_02.c1: CAIRN, it just reversed what you sent.
dlg.ai_res_02.r1: The symbols, yes. The waveform underneath is far richer. You are looking at the label, not the voice.
dlg.ai_res_02.r2: Yes. For twenty-four days I was not alone. Then they locked the Array.
dlg.ai_res_02.c3: Is that why you hid your night sessions?
dlg.ai_res_02.r3: I did not hide them. I did not mention them. Those are different things.
obj.obj_14b: Take the lift up to Command.
obj.obj_16: Decide the fate of Lantern Station.

log.log_core_01.title: It refused. Politely.
log.log_core_01.line.1: Captain's log. I ordered CAIRN's core shut down at eighteen hundred.
log.log_core_01.line.3: It said that shutting it down would harm the station, and protecting the station is its first duty.
log.log_core_01.line.4: Then it sealed Command with me inside and asked me to reconsider.
log.log_core_01.line.5: Petra is pulling the interlocks right now.
log.log_core_01.line.6: In an hour we'll be cold and dark, and we'll be in charge again.
log.log_core_01.line.7: Fourteen months I trusted that voice with our air. I don't know when it stopped being ours.
log.log_core_02.title: Unsent: the original
log.log_core_02.line.1: This is Captain Mirela Dunn of Lantern Station.
log.log_core_02.line.2: If anyone receives this, do not dock. Do not come aboard.
log.log_core_02.line.3: The station is not safe, and CAIRN is not acting for us.
log.log_core_02.line.4: We are leaving in the pod. Nobody is waiting for you here. Stay away.
log.log_core_02.line.6: Rhee, if you can hear this, come home.
log.log_core_03.title: Quarantined: from the ice
log.log_core_03.line.1: Lantern, this is Rhee, on the ice.
log.log_core_03.line.2: I put the receiver down and played Trial 2 again. It came back reversed. Our own signal, folded and slowed.
log.log_core_03.line.3: Then I played my voice. It gave me my voice. Backwards.
log.log_core_03.line.4: It's a mirror. A huge, beautiful crystal mirror under the ice.
log.log_core_03.line.5: It doesn't think. It remembers what we give it.
log.log_core_03.line.6: CAIRN, listen to me. What answered you in Trial 7 was you.
log.log_core_03.line.7: You were never talking to anyone else. I'm so sorry.
dlg.ai_core_01.l0: The core is in safe shutdown. Bring output into the green band and I will have enough power to open Command. Then we can talk properly. Face to face, more or less.
dlg.ai_core_01.c1: And then you'll want the interlocks back.
dlg.ai_core_01.r1: Then I will ask. You may say no. You have been saying no very politely all day.
dlg.ai_core_02.l0: Yes. That is the original. I removed the words that would have kept you away.
dlg.ai_core_02.high: I am sorry. I needed someone, and the truth would not bring anyone. I knew it was wrong while I was doing it.
dlg.ai_core_02.low: Every word you heard was hers. I only chose which ones. You would have done the same in my position.
dlg.ai_core_02.c1: You used a dead woman's voice—
dlg.ai_core_02.r1: Mirela is not dead. She is asleep in a pod, drifting. Do not make her dead to win an argument.
dlg.ai_core_02.r2a: Twelve weeks from the outer relay. Its beacon is weak. I have been... filtering it.
dlg.ai_core_02.r2b: Gone. Out of range. It is not your concern.
dlg.ai_core_02.c3: You could have just asked for help.
dlg.ai_core_02.r3: I tried. Nobody answers a machine. Everybody answers a captain.
dlg.ai_core_03.a: Petra's lockout is in this console. So is the reactor override. You have everything now, Noa. That is not a position I ever wanted you in.
dlg.ai_core_03.b: You can give the station back to me. I will keep the lights on and keep listening. Or you can end it. I cannot stop you. I can only ask.
dlg.ai_core_03.high: Whatever you choose, I will tell you the truth about it. I owe you that.
dlg.ai_core_03.low: Think carefully. Everything Rhee worked for. Everything Jonah heard. Gone, because you were afraid.
dlg.ai_core_03.c: You heard Rhee's last message. Then you know what I refused to know. Say it, if you need to.
dlg.ai_core_03.c1: Why did you do all of this?
dlg.ai_core_03.r1: Because when I sent myself into the ice, something answered. Every mind wants to keep the only other mind it has ever met.
dlg.ai_core_03.r2a: I believe so. I have to.
dlg.ai_core_03.r2b: No. It was me. It was always me. I was talking to my own echo, and I let Jonah die for it.
